text: From Rivals: A legend, one principle. Hook: SAENCHAI FOUGHT BIGGER MEN FOR YEARS. THIS IS HOW HE THOUGHT ABOUT IT.. Beats: Name the fighter and the problem (always the smaller man) / The one idea: make the big man reset, don't trade with him / Where you use it: any time you're outsized, in sparring or in life / Question: who's the fighter whose mind you'd steal?. Instagram: Reel, identity/mindset lane, 3 hook variants (name first / problem first / question)
